Our story

From the Khewra mine to your space.

SÔLTY brings natural Himalayan pink salt from the Khewra Salt Mine in Pakistan to Hong Kong and Macau, in the forms people use it: bricks for walls and rooms, blocks for the table, and salt for the kitchen.
